decisions.reason: The medical examination light serves institutional users where products stay in service for long periods, but it has not been visible on the website since 2019, and LED lighting ranges are refreshed often, so there is some risk of withdrawal.

The designer task light is a relaunch of a proven popular design close to the core offer, but by 2022 it is several years old and not recently visible, so replacement by a newer LED version is plausible.
The pendant office luminaire was launched in 2019, is close to the core office lighting business and is still within a normal product life cycle, so withdrawal within a year is fairly unlikely.
The premium pendant line with several models is recent and close to the core offer, and the firm is expanding, so it is likely to stay on the market.
